entries.name: Trap
entries.description: A concealed mechanical or arcane snare.

entries.name: Unstable ceiling
entries.description: Cracks fracture the overhead masonry; loose stones threaten to give way.

entries.name: Difficult terrain
entries.description: Jagged rubble, slippery sludge, or jagged scree severely slows movement.

entries.name: Deep pit/chasm
entries.description: A sheer drop cuts across the floor into darkness below.

entries.name: Toxic growth
entries.description: Spore-bloated fungi or noxious briars release irritating spores.

entries.name: Flooded area
entries.description: Murky, stagnant water reaches knee or waist height, hiding the floor beneath.

entries.name: Unstable floor
entries.description: Several flagstones shift and groan noticeably underfoot.

entries.name: Thick smoke/fog
entries.description: A dense, clinging vapor reduces visibility to mere paces and stings the eyes.

entries.name: Vermin infestation
entries.description: A swarming nest of biting insects, venomous spiders, or carrion rats.

entries.name: Extreme heat/cold
entries.description: A severe temperature anomaly chills the bone or stifles the breath.

entries.name: Blocked route
entries.description: Heavy collapsed rubble or barricaded debris obstructs passage.

entries.name: Supernatural disturbance
entries.description: Unsettling whispers, phantom chills, or gravity anomalies stir the air.
